services.title: Diagnostics and check engine work
services.body: The fault gets traced to its actual cause before anything is replaced, so you pay for the part that failed and not the three beside it.

evidence.text: They diagnosed the issues within one day and provided a very good breakdown of what was found.
evidence.also: The mechanic here was very nice, he diagnosed the problem quickly, got the parts I needed in the same day!

services.title: Engine repair
services.body: The engine comes apart far enough to find the actual fault, not far enough to run up the bill.

evidence.text: I had some engine troubles and they fixed me right up.

services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

evidence.text: He replaced all four brake pads and the front rotors at a fair price.

services.title: Steering, suspension and alignment
services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

evidence.text: He even recommended that I have my suspension checked on a future visit instead of telling me to fix everything at once.
evidence.also: They replaced my wheel bearing the same day without an appointment.

services.title: Oil changes and routine maintenance
services.body: Oil, filters and fluids are done to the schedule the manufacturer set, with what we found written on the ticket.

evidence.text: I would highly recommend DJC Auto Repair to anyone who needs vehicle maintenance.

reviews.author: mike
reviews.text: I drove almost an hour to get here after a friend recommended them, and I'd do it again without hesitation. I came in frustrated. My car had been looked at by multiple shops and nobody could give me real answers. These guys figured it out the next day, called me back, and sent videos walking me through exactly what was wrong. The inspection report alone was more detailed than anything I'd seen before. My vehicle needs significant work, transmission, motor mounts, sway bar linkage, but for the first time I actually understand what's going on and have a plan to fix it. The owner took time to explain everything, gave me options, and was upfront about pricing. No runaround, no upselling, just straight talk and genuine care. If you've been bounced around from shop to shop and feel like nobody can help you, come here. They're the real deal. 10/10.

reviews.author: Kevin Henson
reviews.text: We took my daughter’s car to DJC for several issues. They diagnosed the issues within one day and provided a very good breakdown of what was found. They completed the work the next day and the car is running and riding great! Highly recommend for their high quality work and great customer service.

reviews.author: Suman Capirichio
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this mechanic. He replaced all four brake pads and the front rotors at a fair price. He also found and fixed a brake fluid leak without charging me extra. He was honest, explained everything clearly, and didn’t pressure me into unnecessary repairs. My car is driving smoothly now, and all the brake noise is gone. He even recommended that I have my suspension checked on a future visit instead of telling me to fix everything at once. I really appreciate his (josh and surjo) honesty, professionalism, and quality work . I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: Amelia Garcia
reviews.text: I live nearby! My tire got punctured by a nail in the road, and I found this shop online! I wasn't sure if they required an appointment, but I went to the front desk anyway, and they told me it would only take 20 minutes! Since I needed to drive to another place, this was fantastic! And the price was reasonable too!

reviews.author: David Russell
reviews.text: Add a star please! Josh runs a tight and honest ship. These guys absolutely refuse to sell you anything you don't need! They did what they said! Didn't charge me an arm and a leg and my truck runs and sounds freaking amazing! Thanks guys. You have my business for good going forward

reviews.author: Bryan Gonterman
reviews.text: Excellent service and upfront honest. Shows you the issue and gives a great fair price with no hassle estimates. Highly recommend them

reviews.author: Kamren Tillis
reviews.text: So far am I 32 years of living this is the best auto repair shop I’ve ever been to in my life. They’re very respectful. They’re very honest. They don’t try to get over on you. The prices are so affordable and the customer service is top-notch. I highly recommend anyone who sees this review. Please go check them out yourself.

reviews.author: Flavia Santos
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Josué was referred to me by friends and truly stands out for his honesty, professionalism, and quick, reliable service. His team is also excellent, always friendly, attentive, and helpful. After a few visits, I can confidently say this is the best place and you can fully trust them with your car.

reviews.author: Luiz Guimaraes
reviews.text: It was a very good job, treated me very well and explained everything. They are very honest with everything they do!!

reviews.author: Shari Cofresi
reviews.text: Josh, Sergio, and the rest of the team are amazing! They are efficient and know what they are doing. Also very reasonable with their prices. My family and I have been going to them for years now and they have always done right by us. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Stephen Howard Kay
reviews.text: They replaced my wheel bearing the same day without an appointment. Incredible people with honest service and all with a fair price. A true diamond in the rough in the Charleston metro area! I've finally found my auto mechanic in Summerville!

reviews.author: JTII
reviews.text: Very good service and excellent work. The staff was extremely friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout the entire experience. They made sure everything was done properly and took the time to answer any questions that were needed.

reviews.author: Everett Rossy
reviews.text: DJC Auto Repair gives you honest fair prices , unlike some shops in town. Sergio and his crew are courteous and thorough. my new go to shop!!

reviews.author: Vera Edwards
reviews.text: I was greeted very warmly. they performed great service and are very knowledgeable. I will tell people I know with car issues to come here for great service! Thank you.

reviews.author: Emerson Marques
reviews.text: Excellent and fast service, and unbeatable prices. I've been a customer for a long time; they are super honest and trustworthy. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Danielle Edwards
reviews.text: Very kind, honest, and professional service from start to finish! I came in with no idea what was going on and everything was explained thoroughly to us as it was being done. I couldn’t have asked for better service especially so quickly!

reviews.author: Morgan Watts
reviews.text: The mechanic here was very nice, he diagnosed the problem quickly, got the parts I needed in the same day! It was a very smooth process working with them and I will absolutely come back again!

reviews.author: Priscilla Oliveira
reviews.text: Excellent service! I’ve been getting serviced by Josue and his team for about 8 years now. This one time my car had an issue and I took it to someone else, they said it needed a $1600 part and they couldn’t find it blabla… it stayed in the shop for about a month without fixing. I contacted Josue, towed my car to him and he fixed a totally different issue for $180 next day!!! 10/10

reviews.author: Clixluke Clan
reviews.text: They did an absolute amazing job on my truck. They put a new engine in, fill all the fluids up and the truck runs and drives awesome now. They have done a lot of work for me and always do a good job and very reliable. Definitely recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Abby J
reviews.text: I brought my truck in and it was worked on immediately even with a full garage. They knew my dilemma and understood and stayed open after hours to finish the job. They made sure I was taken care of during the wait. They have fair and reasonable prices. I’m sad to see that they are now closed on Saturdays, but Overall excellent business!!!!

reviews.author: melissa leonard
reviews.text: Incredibly kind, took me in the shop and showed me everything going on with my car, didn’t just tell. Zero pressure and helped me understand the urgency of each issue my car had

reviews.author: Jason Ziegler
reviews.text: Very honest, trustworthy and God respecting people own, run and operate this business. They have a reputation to uphold with their family name on it.

reviews.author: Rick Casarez
reviews.text: Very professional, clean, and timely service. They are so honest and will let you know if something is needed or not. Pleasurable staff from the front office to the garage. Seems very family oriented and respectful. No haggle, no hassle environment. Highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: scott lewis
reviews.text: Sergio helped me out a lot with a big issue I had with a stuck sensor quickly and he made it easy. Definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: Cey'Lon Grant
reviews.text: Great service all the way around I 100% recommend no they explained everything and answered every question.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Curnett
reviews.text: I have a Porsche, Panamera S and I'm very particular as to the shop and mechanics that I allow to work on it. The technicians at DJC Auto Repair did a wonderful job in diagnosing and correcting exhaust issues and door lock issues. I think they are highly regarded. And I will be sticking with them for the future so that I will have great service and enjoy the work of professionals who are polite, efficient and very friendly. Again, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jonathan Adams
reviews.text: Josh at DJC Auto Repair was fantastic! He replaced my battery quickly and was professional, knowledgeable, and kind. I really appreciated his great service, highly recommend!

reviews.author: J ROKK
reviews.text: GREAT PLACE. EVERYTIME THEY ARE ON TIME AND GOOD QUALITY AND PEOPLE AND THEY LET YOU KNOW WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE!

reviews.author: debby carrier
reviews.text: Quoted $100 diagnostic charged $150.00. Wanted $1100.00 to repair but wouldn't guarantee he could fix it

reviews.author: Debbie Swan
reviews.text: They are very honest and work to ensure they get the best price for you. This is the second time they have worked on my car, first time was a year ago. This time they told me it would take 1 day to do everything I asked for (shocks & struts all around, front end work including cv axels, control arms and all that) and by end of the day I was called to come get my car. I 100% recommend DJC Auto repair. My car is a 2011 Kia Serento.

reviews.author: Rafael Botaro
reviews.text: These guys are true professionals! Fast service and FAIR prices! Josh offers a true consultative approach and his staff is just as impressive! I trust them fully with all of our vehicles.

reviews.author: shane rast
reviews.text: I showed up with no appointment and asked about my Battery acting like it was starting to fail. The staff was able to scan the computer and told me that everything was fine. They also said if the indication come back to take a picture and he would figure it out. I would definitely recommend this repair shop to everyone. Thanks F150 owner

reviews.author: John Williams
reviews.text: Josh is wonderful. Helped me out in a pinch with a blown tire. Highly reccomended. Now I can make it back to Florida.

reviews.author: Bryan Wojciechowicz
reviews.text: The infamous grid heater bolt killed my old 6.7 Cummins motor . Josh and his team of mechanics did an excellent job installing new motor for a fair price !

reviews.author: Hayden Workman
reviews.text: I fell victim to diesel gas contamination at a local gas station, my car was undrivable. I googled local mechanics, when I found DJC. I called and within an hour my car was towed there and being worked on, they were able to clean out my entire fuel system, and I was able to pick up my car the same day! They were very nice and so quick! Definitely gained a permanent customer from me and husband.

reviews.author: Alexandria Plummer
reviews.text: The absolute best team ever. Answered all of my questions with ease, took care of any concern and was time efficient highly recommend for any car situation that you may have. Real review I really appreciate them so much

reviews.author: Katherine K
reviews.text: DJC Auto Repair was very welcoming. They immediately responded to our emergent circumstance. They got us in immediately and were dedicated to helping and were very effective and diligent. Wouldn’t go anywhere else. Thank you! The amenities provided as well were top-knotch.

reviews.author: Andrea James
reviews.text: Great prices. Reliable service. Spectacular Work! Will definitely spread the word about the DJC Auto Repair! They were full and still fixed my truck in under an hour!

reviews.author: gaston gator
reviews.text: Water hose busted going down Central Ave. Pulled into first shop I came to... Thank you DJ Auto ,they immediately got to work and repaired the issue. Had me back on my way in less than a hour. This is definitely my new go too shop! ! !

reviews.author: Christian Reader
reviews.text: Awesome place!! Went there on my z400 to see if they could let me use a torque wrench to take off my front sprocket nutt and he, while busy with another job, helped me out within 5 minutes and no charge. Very happy and pleased with the man who helped me

reviews.author: Longeno Pavis
reviews.text: My SUV had a rusted and failing exhaust system that needed to be replaced right away and I came to DJC Auto Repair for help. Josh was able to order the parts and schedule the job for me the next day! I could not be more happy and thankful! These guys are real pros and true gentlemen and I recommend them very highly!

reviews.author: Joel Bense
reviews.text: These people are extremely honest. We took our Highlander to a major tire store in Virginia, where we had been advised that new rear struts would be necessary in order to pass the Virginia .inspection. As it turned out.the owner of DJC. AUTO REPAIR told me that my struts were perfectly OK ! DJC are relatively new to the Summerville area………….. and yes, this is where I will be taking my repair business going forward. Honest people are nice to know who one feels comfortable with in knowing that I won’t be getting “ ripped off” As we continued to talk, I came to realize that this guy is a true Christian for sure. ( my kind of man). Joel Bense

reviews.author: Stephanie Droze Tolppa
reviews.text: These fellas are great. I had some engine troubles and they fixed me right up. I would highly recommend DJC Auto Repair to anyone who needs vehicle maintenance.

reviews.author: Wanda Husser
reviews.text: Josh the mechanic was very professional i will definitely come back for future repairs he really knows his line of work!!!!!!

reviews.author: melany chacha
reviews.text: They were very kind and helpful. They did a wonderful job and did not took long. They do fantastic work for a fair price!

reviews.author: Fernando
reviews.text: Amazing service, I’ve been coming to these guys for years and have never left me down. Great quality, professionalism and friendliness.

reviews.author: Jake Puorro
reviews.text: Great quality at a very good rate! Did not try to upsell me but made me aware of future potential problems that were not necessary today. Very friendly and professional, work was done efficiently, was able to pick up the next day.

reviews.author: Matthew Negron
reviews.text: Sergio is amazing and honest. I would highly recommend this place for services. A very friendly environment and good mechanics.
